response.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_remaining_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT sg.site_code, sg.insurance_status, sg.avg_remaining_storage, sg.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, sg.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(gm.mean_remaining_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM site_groups AS sg CROSS JOIN group_mean AS gm WHERE gm.mean_remaining_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN sg.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(gm.mean_remaining_storage, 0) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, storage_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
